inventorySemantics.package-root: One identity for each published package name.
inventorySemantics.subpath: One identity for each non-root package export key.
inventorySemantics.runtime-export: One identity for each top-level ESM runtime export at a package entry point.
inventorySemantics.declaration-only-export: One identity for each top-level declaration export name absent from that entry point at runtime.
inventorySemantics.namespace-runtime-export: One identity for each runtime member of an explicitly exported core namespace object.
inventorySemantics.namespace-declaration-only-export: One identity for each declaration namespace member absent from its namespace object at runtime.
inventorySemantics.documented-operation: One module-qualified identity for each explicitly named public work operation or setup factory in canonical 0.3 README/docs: the seven end-user work operations, four provider Layer exports, and effect-build/Provider#define. Integration capabilities described only conceptually are already covered as exports and are not fabricated into exact documentation-name observations.

targetCoordinateGrammar.targetSet: An array of exact coordinates means the 0.3 identity split into those explicit contracts; it never means fallback selection.

dispositionDefinitions.rename: The semantic operation survives under a different public name; no old-name alias is permitted.
dispositionDefinitions.replace: The 0.3 identity or contract is superseded by a different 0.4 identity or shape; no compatibility delegate is permitted.
dispositionDefinitions.remove: The 0.3 identity has no one-for-one 0.4 replacement. Callers must delete or redesign that use.

rules.rationale: M8 and the R6 deferral leave the existing five-package train intact. This retains package identities only; each root export surface is mapped independently below.

rules.noReplacementReason: D4 removes the generic Integration path. The frozen Author modules encode narrower tool, borrowed-output, and executable laws; none is a drop-in replacement for this entry point.
rules.rationale: Delete imports from effect-build/Integration and redesign against the exact frozen Author module or official Effect primitive that owns the needed invariant.

rules.noReplacementReason: D4 removes the generic Provider path, and D2 rejects a generic command-compiler abstraction. Author/Tool#define is a narrower tool-author contract, not a compatible Provider.define replacement.
rules.rationale: Delete imports from effect-build/Provider; provider-specific operations own their policy and official Effect primitives own process mechanics.

The frozen Artifact and Author/Tool modules replace the 0.3 number-based byte count, flat artifact records, and stage/tool observations with exact mode-indexed artifacts and canonical tool observations.

rules.noReplacementReason: The frozen surface has no universal BuildError module or one-for-one replacement. Each admitted operation owns an exact error export, so callers must narrow at that operation boundary.
rules.rationale: Delete the core BuildError namespace and its members; use the selected operation module's exact error union instead of a compatibility alias.

rules.noReplacementReason: The frozen surface has no JavaScriptBundle module. Author/BorrowedOutput is a lower-level ownership law and Esbuild Build returns native memory output; neither is a drop-in replacement for the 0.3 live Node-resolution bundle capability.
rules.rationale: Delete JavaScriptBundle and redesign the call around the exact admitted provider operation and, only when authoring an adapter, Author/BorrowedOutput.
The exact effect-build/Matrix module replaces the 0.3 aggregate error with InvalidInput plus an ordered Success/Failure Report; scalar operation modules expose their exact MatrixReport projection.
The exact effect-build/SystemTarget module replaces the 0.3 Target namespace. ResolutionTarget has no successor and is mapped separately as a removal.

rules.noReplacementReason: The frozen Artifact and Author contracts contain no public linear stage tuple. Tool observations and final artifact observations are modeled separately.
rules.rationale: Delete Artifact.StageObservation; it is neither a receipt nor a provenance contract and receives no alias.

rules.noReplacementReason: The frozen SystemTarget module models executable system targets. The 0.3 JavaScript-bundle ResolutionTarget literal belonged to the removed bundle capability and has no successor.
rules.rationale: Delete Target.ResolutionTarget; do not conflate Node module resolution with executable system target selection.

rules.noReplacementReason: The entire generic Integration public path is a named D4 removal. Frozen Author modules and official Effect process APIs have narrower contracts and are not compatibility aliases.
rules.rationale: Every 0.3 Integration runtime and declaration export is removed with its containing subpath; no compatibility delegate survives.

rules.noReplacementReason: The entire generic Provider public path and command-compiler factory are named hard-cut removals. Frozen Author/Tool#define does not recreate the Provider abstraction.
rules.rationale: Every 0.3 Provider runtime and declaration export is removed with its containing subpath; provider policy stays operation-specific.
CAN-BUN-012 is frozen at effect-build-bun/CompileExecutable#compileExecutable. The root callable is removed; only the namespace re-export remains.
The exact CompileExecutable subpath owns Artifact, CompileExecutableInput, Options, and Target. No corresponding root type aliases survive.
The derived matrix operation is frozen at effect-build-bun/CompileExecutable#compileExecutableMatrix with CompileExecutableMatrixInput and MatrixReport; its cells invoke CAN-BUN-012 exactly once.

rules.noReplacementReason: D16 removes the Bun continuation. Native Bun build candidates CAN-BUN-006 through CAN-BUN-010 are distinct operations, not a drop-in replacement for the old continuation and bundle/error types.
rules.rationale: Delete the old continuation and its bundle-specific contracts. All Bun native build candidates are deferred in the frozen 0.4 surface, so there is no replacement operation to import.
The ambiguous root Compiler/Service identity is replaced by the exact effect-build-bun/CompileExecutable#Compiler operation service. No root alias survives.
Selected Bun acquisition is frozen as effect-build-bun/CompileExecutable#layer with LayerOptions. The root callable is removed and the root exposes only the CompileExecutable namespace.
CAN-DENO-010 is frozen at effect-build-deno/CompileExecutable#compileExecutable. The root callable is removed; only the namespace re-export remains.
The exact CompileExecutable subpath owns Artifact, CompileExecutableInput, Options, PermissionValue, Permissions, and Target. No corresponding root aliases survive.
The derived matrix operation is frozen at effect-build-deno/CompileExecutable#compileExecutableMatrix with CompileExecutableMatrixInput and MatrixReport; its cells invoke CAN-DENO-010 exactly once.
The ambiguous root Compiler identity is replaced by the exact effect-build-deno/CompileExecutable#Compiler operation service. No root alias survives.
Selected Deno acquisition is frozen as effect-build-deno/CompileExecutable#layer with LayerOptions. The root callable is removed and the root exposes only the CompileExecutable namespace.

rules.noReplacementReason: D4's withJavaScriptBundle removal applies to the old narrow Esbuild continuation. CAN-ESB-001/002 and context candidates are native operations with different request, result, ownership, and lifecycle contracts.
rules.rationale: Delete the narrow continuation and bundle-materialization contracts. The frozen Build and Context operations have different request, result, ownership, and lifecycle contracts.
The old narrow JavaScriptBundleInput and EsbuildBundleError declarations map exactly to the frozen one-shot BuildInput and BuildError contracts.
The old one-shot diagnostic and validation exports collapse into the exact effect-build-esbuild/Build#BuildError contract; their class-level root identities do not survive.
The old root service and Layer surface splits exactly across frozen Build and Context modules. Callers select the one-shot or scoped-context lane explicitly; no root callable survives.
The released direct Node SEA operation maps to frozen CAN-NODE-001 at effect-build-node-sea/AssembleExecutable#assembleExecutable. createExecutable is removed with no alias.
The frozen AssembleExecutable module replaces the old direct operation's input, artifact, and error declarations. The 0.3 stage tuple has no successor and is removed separately.

rules.noReplacementReason: The frozen AssembleExecutable module returns its exact Artifact and exposes no public NodeSeaStage tuple.
rules.rationale: Delete NodeSeaStage; the final artifact observation is the contract and no legacy stage alias survives.
Selected Node acquisition is frozen as AssembleExecutable#Assembler and #layer with LayerOptions. CAN-NODE-002/003 are deferred legacy-only and receive no mapping or alias.
